old_caption: The video captures a serene sky scene dominated by large, fluffy white clouds. The clouds are illuminated by bright sunlight streaming through them, creating a dramatic interplay of light and shadow. The sun's rays pierce through the gaps in the clouds, casting beams of light across the sky. These beams appear to move slightly, suggesting a gentle breeze or the natural movement of the clouds. The sky transitions from a deep blue at the top to lighter shades near the horizon, where the clouds are more prominent. The overall atmosphere is peaceful and dynamic, with the clouds continuously shifting and changing shape, while the sunlight adds a sense of depth and movement to the scene. There are no visible characters or animals in the video; the focus remains entirely on the natural beauty of the sky and its ever-changing patterns.

caption: The video captures a fixed outdoor view of a bright blue sky dominated by a large backlit cumulus cloud on the right, the sun hidden so that crepuscular rays fan toward the upper left. A shadowed cloud bank fills the lower frame, two thin power lines run diagonally across the lower third, and a touch of foliage sits at the corner. The camera and power lines remain steady relative to the frame edges. The summit of the right-hand cloud slowly reshapes, its pointed tower lowering and rounding out, and a bright backlit gap opens at the top, changing the silhouette with little horizontal translation. The fan of rays subtly shifts in angle and intensity as the cloud edge evolves, the leftmost bands repositioning slightly. Small wisps and rim highlights on the lower bank undergo minor, gradual evolution, with little overall drift of the cloud masses. The visible motion is cloud and light evolution rather than obvious camera movement.

Audit this candidate caption against the actual chronological images, and correct factual errors.
This is a TEMPORALLY CROPPED EXCERPT from a longer video, not a complete event or a loop.
The first view may already be mid-action; the last view need not contain completion. Different
endpoints are normal, not physical errors. Do not add unseen causes, onset, stopping or outcomes.
An internal editing cut is not evidence of physical motion connecting the views.

Check identification before physical interpretation: a reflection is not a separate actor;
a powder/smoke/liquid outline or shadow is not automatically the boundary of a solid object;
an apparent change caused by occlusion/viewpoint is not automatically material deformation.
Do not claim contact, bending, compression, melting, disintegration or structural recovery unless
the appropriate material/surface itself provides visible evidence. Do not infer a force or earlier
collision just because the visible configuration would be compatible with it.
Compare several frames before asserting translation, rotation, direction, unchanged position or
camera tracking. A single visible texture/seam does not prove spin. Avoid unnecessary absolute
claims of stillness, no motion, no camera motion or 'exactly' synchronized changes.
Remove invented scene details and explanations, but keep clearly visible ongoing motion and
processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.

Retain the WISA English narrative style, detail density and paragraph structure. Aim for the
provided original word count within 85%-115%, using genuinely visible details and process.
Do not add repetition, watermark/logo descriptions or atmospheric filler to reach a word count.
Do not shorten a rich caption into a terse technical checklist. Avoid annotation phrases such as
'this mid-segment', 'the excerpt', 'the frame', 'these images', 'observed evidence' in the caption.
This is a direct video description, not an analysis note. No mandatory beginning/end formula.
Complete every sentence. If accuracy requires a substantial length difference, explain it outside
the caption; do not fill missing context by imagination. Optional synonym edits are not needed.

Return JSON {"decision":"keep|edit", "issues":[{"quote":"exact span in candidate caption",
"problem":"concrete visual mismatch or unsupported assertion"}], "caption":"complete final caption",
"length_note":"empty unless required"}. Keep means unchanged caption and no issues. An edit
must actually correct the cited issue. This is a fallible automatic review, not proof of correctness.

draft_caption: The video captures a fixed outdoor view of a bright blue sky dominated by a large backlit cumulus cloud on the right, the sun hidden so that crepuscular rays fan toward the upper left. A shadowed cloud bank fills the bottom-left, two thin power lines run diagonally across the lower third, and a touch of foliage sits at the corner. The camera and the power lines hold a constant position relative to the frame edges throughout. The summit of the right-hand cloud slowly reshapes, its pointed tower lowering and rounding out, and a bright backlit gap opens at the top, changing the silhouette without the cloud translating. The fan of rays subtly shifts in angle and intensity as the cloud edge evolves, the leftmost bands repositioning slightly. Small wisps and rim highlights on the lower bank undergo minor, gradual evolution, with no overall drift of the cloud masses. The apparent motion is cloud and light evolution, not camera movement.
